topStories.headline: Grocery Outlet Opens on Bay Street, Ending Three-Year Food Desert at North Beach–Wharf Border
topStories.dek: A new Grocery Outlet at 350 Bay St. opened Thursday, August 13, filling a gap left by the closure of Safeway in 2023.
topStories.body:
After three years of vacancy, the former Safeway location at 350 Bay St. in the NorthPoint Shopping Center reopened Thursday as a Grocery Outlet, offering brand-name deals and bargain-priced groceries to a neighborhood that had felt the pinch since 2023. The original Safeway had closed citing unmet financial expectations, leaving roughly 20,000 residents within a half-mile of the site with one fewer full-service grocery option.

Grocery Outlet's entry into the 30,000-square-foot space was announced in September 2024, followed by nearly two years of construction. District 3 Supervisor Danny Sauter had publicly championed the project, calling the opening an improvement to daily life for residents of North Beach and nearby Chinatown.

The new store sits at the border between Fisherman's Wharf and North Beach, joining Trader Joe's as the area's major grocery options. The SF Standard described the store's interior as freshly polished, stocked with a wide range of brands at sharp price points ahead of its public opening Thursday at 10 a.m.

The opening drew community members who had followed the site's long vacancy. Residents had previously noted that without a neighborhood grocery, they faced bus trips to Market Street or the Embarcadero just to shop for food.

topStories.headline: Pizza, Bagel & Beer Festival Returns to North Beach Saturday with Live Music in Washington Square
topStories.dek: The fourth annual festival on August 15 expands to Washington Square Park for the first time, adding a live music stage alongside its signature food and beer lineup.
topStories.body:
The SF Pizza, Bagel & Beer Festival returns to North Beach this Saturday, August 15, running from noon to 4 p.m. along Stockton and Filbert Streets and into Washington Square Park. Hosted by 13-time World Pizza Champion Tony Gemignani in partnership with the San Francisco Italian Athletic Club Foundation, the event is now in its fourth year and has sold out each prior edition.

New for 2026 is a dedicated live music stage in Washington Square Park, featuring swing, jazz, and rockabilly performances throughout the afternoon — a first for the festival. Vendors include Tony's Pizza Napoletana, Capo's, Slice House, A16, Flour + Water Pizzeria, Boichik Bagels, The Laundromat, Dago Bagel, and approximately 15 breweries including Sierra Nevada, Fieldwork Brewing, and Lagunitas.

Ticket tiers range from $30 for children ages 5–12 to $275 for VIP access, which includes one-hour early entry and a private lounge at the SFIAC with an open bar. Proceeds benefit local nonprofits including the Salesian Boys & Girls Club, Saints Peter and Paul School, Friends of Washington Square Park, and the North Beach Business Association. Over the past three years, the festival has raised more than $225,000 for local causes.

The SFMTA has issued a service alert noting that the 39 Coit route will reroute all day Friday and Saturday, with street closures along Filbert between Stockton and Powell and on Stockton between Filbert and Union from 5 a.m. Friday through 10 p.m. Saturday.

topStories.headline: Fisherman's Wharf Forward Plaza Nears Completion as Summer Construction Window Closes
topStories.dek: The Port of San Francisco's $10 million Taylor Street public plaza project, built on the site of the demolished Alioto's Restaurant, targeted a summer 2026 completion as construction work wraps up.
topStories.body:
The Port of San Francisco's flagship Fisherman's Wharf Forward project is entering its final phase, with the new 5,000-square-foot public plaza on Taylor Street designed to open views of the Inner Lagoon fishing fleet that had long been blocked by the now-demolished Alioto's Restaurant. The historic seafood restaurant had operated for nearly a century before closing permanently in 2022; demolition and abatement work ran from late 2025 through this summer.

The plaza, designed by San Francisco-based firm SITELAB urban studio, will feature wave-shaped seating, picnic tables, string lights, and interpretive signage celebrating the Wharf's fishing heritage. An Inner Lagoon overlook along Al Scoma Way is also part of the near-term work, along with new lighting in the lagoon to illuminate the working fishing fleet and historic vessels.

Temporary sidewalk and lane closures along Taylor Street between Jefferson Street and The Embarcadero have been in effect since December 2025. The Port's longer-term Fisherman's Wharf Forward planning extends through 2030 and beyond, encompassing seawall strengthening, flood resilience infrastructure, and new retail development. Public outreach and engagement throughout 2026 will inform those longer-term plans, with a conceptual plan targeted for early 2027.

Mayor Daniel Lurie has cited the project as part of a broader push to revitalize San Francisco's tourism economy. The Wharf attracted more than 10 million visitors in 2024, making it the city's most visited neighborhood, according to Placer.ai figures cited by the Port.

events.title: SF Pizza, Bagel & Beer Festival
events.location: Stockton & Filbert Streets / Washington Square Park, North Beach
events.description: The fourth annual festival hosted by 13-time World Pizza Champion Tony Gemignani features 30+ pizzerias, bagelries, and 15+ breweries, plus a new live music stage in Washington Square Park with swing, jazz, and rockabilly. Proceeds benefit local nonprofits.

events.title: Exploratorium Storytime Science for Kids: Space Is the Place
events.location: Exploratorium, Pier 15, Embarcadero at Green St.
events.description: A storybook read-aloud followed by a hands-on related activity geared toward children ages 6–10 and their grown-ups, at one of San Francisco's most celebrated interactive museums.

events.title: Free Housing Clinic — North Beach Tenants Committee
events.location: Telegraph Neighborhood Center, 660 Lombard St. at Mason
events.description: The North Beach Tenants Committee, in conjunction with the Chinatown Community Development Center, holds a free monthly housing clinic to counsel tenants on evictions and buyouts.

events.title: Mustache Harbor at Bimbo's 365 Club
events.location: Bimbo's 365 Club, 1025 Columbus Ave., North Beach
events.description: Live music at the legendary North Beach supper club and concert hall, one of San Francisco's most storied entertainment venues since 1931.

events.title: North Beach First Fridays Art Crawl
events.location: Multiple galleries, bars, and restaurants, North Beach
events.description: On the first Friday of every month, over a dozen North Beach galleries, museums, bars, and restaurants open late for a free self-guided art crawl organized by the North Beach Business Association and the San Francisco Arts Commission.

events.title: Exploratorium After Dark (18+)
events.location: Exploratorium, Pier 15, Embarcadero at Green St.
events.description: Every Thursday evening, the Exploratorium transforms into an adults-only science playground with DJs, cocktails, and full access to 650+ interactive exhibits on the Embarcadero waterfront.

moreNews.headline: Caffe Trieste Marks 70 Years as a North Beach Institution
moreNews.body: San Francisco's beloved Caffè Trieste, which opened at 601 Vallejo St. in 1956 as the first espresso coffee house on the West Coast, celebrated its 70th anniversary in April 2026 with discounted espresso and live music. The cash-only café has long been a gathering place for poets, writers, and artists — including Beat Generation figures — and continues to draw locals and visitors alike. The café remains open seven days a week, 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.

moreNews.headline: Exploratorium After Dark Canceled August 13 Due to PG&E Outage; Regular Hours Resume
moreNews.body: The Exploratorium at Pier 15 announced a special closure of its popular adult-only Thursday After Dark event on August 13 due to a PG&E power outage along the Embarcadero. Ticket holders were automatically refunded. The museum, rated the No. 1 science museum in San Francisco, operates Tuesday through Sunday with regular daytime admission and noted that normal programming would resume following the outage.

moreNews.headline: San Francisco Fleet Week 2026 Set for October 4–12 at Fisherman's Wharf
moreNews.body: San Francisco Fleet Week 2026 is scheduled for October 4–12, with the major air show weekend falling on October 9–11 along the Fisherman's Wharf waterfront. This year's lineup includes the Blue Angels, Jack Aces P-51 Demo Team, the Patriots Jet Team, and the Canadian Snowbirds. Fleet Fest — a free public festival at 2860 Taylor St. next to the SkyStar Wheel — will take place on the air show weekend. Residents are encouraged to book waterfront seats and cruise tickets early, as Fleet Week is one of the most heavily attended annual events at the Wharf.

restaurants.name: Molinari Delicatessen
restaurants.description: San Francisco's legendary deli since 1896, known for house-cured meats, stacked sandwiches, focaccia, and imported Italian specialties.

restaurants.name: Caffe Trieste
restaurants.description: The first espresso house on the West Coast (1956), a Beat Generation landmark serving coffee, pastries, and weekend live music at the corner of Vallejo and Grant.

restaurants.name: Tony's Pizza Napoletana
restaurants.description: 13-time World Pizza Champion Tony Gemignani's flagship North Beach restaurant, serving 12 pizza styles fired in seven different ovens alongside antipasti, pasta, and a full bar.

restaurants.name: Flour + Water Pizzeria
restaurants.description: Chic North Beach flagship from the Flour + Water Hospitality Group, serving naturally leavened Neapolitan-inspired pies, mozzarella sticks, and boozy slushies in a stylish dining room with a glass dough room.

restaurants.name: Sotto Mare
restaurants.description: Beloved North Beach seafood institution famed for its award-winning crab cioppino, fresh oysters, clam chowder, and lively maritime décor.

restaurants.name: North Beach Restaurant
restaurants.description: A classic North Beach Italian dining room at the corner of Stockton and Columbus, reopened in 2024 with a refreshed interior and a menu anchored in truffle gnocchi, milanese, and a well-curated wine list.

restaurants.name: Vesuvio Cafe
restaurants.description: A North Beach landmark since 1948, adjacent to City Lights Bookstore and Jack Kerouac Alley, serving craft cocktails and beer in a storied two-story barroom beloved by the Beat Generation.

restaurants.name: Specs' Twelve Adler Museum Café
restaurants.description: An eccentric, beloved North Beach watering hole crammed with memorabilia and maritime curiosities, tucked in Saroyan Place off Columbus since 1968.

restaurants.name: The Saloon
restaurants.description: One of San Francisco's oldest operational taverns, open since 1861 on Grant Avenue, hosting live blues and rock nights in an authentically preserved Victorian barroom.

restaurants.name: Il Casaro Pizzeria
restaurants.description: A neighborhood favorite on Columbus Avenue offering authentic Neapolitan wood-fired pizza with prime sidewalk seating in the heart of North Beach.

restaurants.name: Bocconcino
restaurants.description: A North Beach Tuscan restaurant that opened in 2024 and quickly earned a reputation for outstanding tomato-based pastas, including a celebrated spaghettini burrata.

restaurants.name: Original Joe's
restaurants.description: A storied Italian-American dining institution in North Beach serving classic dishes including Joe's Special, veal, and house pastas in a bustling counter-and-booth setting.

restaurants.name: Mona Lisa Restaurant
restaurants.description: A welcoming neighborhood Italian on Columbus serving classic pastas, seafood, and family-style entrées in the heart of North Beach.

restaurants.name: Tosca Cafe
restaurants.description: A storied North Beach bar and restaurant with deep Bohemian roots, now a refined destination for house cappuccinos (brandy-spiked), Italian-American dishes, and a curated aperitif list.

restaurants.name: Scoma's Restaurant
restaurants.description: A Fisherman's Wharf institution since 1965, Scoma's serves Dungeness crab, cioppino, and locally caught seafood directly on Pier 47 with unobstructed bay views.

restaurants.name: Boudin Bakery & Café
restaurants.description: San Francisco's legendary sourdough bakery, with a flagship Fisherman's Wharf location featuring a museum, demonstration bakery, and bread bowls filled with clam chowder.

restaurants.name: Ghirardelli Chocolate Manufactory & Soda Fountain
restaurants.type: Chocolate shop and ice cream parlor
restaurants.description: San Francisco's beloved chocolate legacy lives on at Ghirardelli Square, where guests enjoy sundaes, hot fudge, and the original 1852 chocolate heritage in a historic waterfront setting.

restaurants.name: Cassava
restaurants.description: A charming neighborhood restaurant in North Beach offering refined brunch and dinner with French-Californian influences and a commitment to local ingredients.

restaurants.name: Belle Cora
restaurants.description: A warmly atmospheric bar on Green Street with outdoor seating under weeping willows, fire pits, 30+ wines by the glass, and live music most weekends.

hotels.name: Argonaut Hotel
hotels.description: A AAA Four Diamond boutique hotel housed in the historic Haslett Warehouse at Hyde Street Pier, offering 252 nautically themed rooms, Bay views, and the Blue Mermaid Restaurant.

hotels.name: Hotel Zephyr San Francisco
hotels.description: A 361-room 'ship-yard chic' hotel built with recycled cargo containers, offering Bay and Alcatraz views, fire pits, outdoor games, and a location steps from Pier 39.

hotels.name: Hyatt Centric Fisherman's Wharf
hotels.description: A 316-room family-friendly hotel with a heated outdoor pool, fitness center, and the Brick & Beam restaurant, set in a nautically themed brick-and-steel building at the Wharf.

hotels.name: San Francisco Marriott Fisherman's Wharf
hotels.description: A large Marriott property a short walk from Pier 39, Ghirardelli Square, and Lombard Street, featuring the Red Fin Restaurant & Lounge and flexible meeting space.

hotels.name: Hotel Zoe Fisherman's Wharf
hotels.description: A charming boutique hotel with courtyard garden, library lounge, and the on-site Pescatore Italian restaurant, steps from Pier 39 and Lombard Street.

hotels.name: Hotel Riu Plaza Fisherman's Wharf
hotels.description: A modern international hotel in the heart of Fisherman's Wharf from the RIU Hotels group, offering contemporary rooms and easy access to the waterfront.

hotels.name: Kimpton Alton Hotel
hotels.description: A stylish Kimpton boutique property steps from Fisherman's Wharf attractions, offering large rooms and the brand's signature complimentary daily wine hour.

hotels.name: Fairmont Heritage Place, Ghirardelli Square
hotels.description: Elegant fractional-ownership residences within the landmark Ghirardelli Square complex, offering spacious suites with full kitchens and Bay views at the edge of Fisherman's Wharf.

shops.name: City Lights Booksellers & Publishers
shops.description: A literary landmark since 1953 and the nation's first all-paperback bookstore, co-founded by poet Lawrence Ferlinghetti, open daily 10 a.m.–10 p.m. with three floors of progressive literature, poetry, and cultural studies.

shops.name: Biordi Art Imports
shops.description: A North Beach institution specializing in hand-painted Italian majolica ceramics imported directly from Deruta, Italy, with over 75 years in the neighborhood.

shops.name: AB Fits
shops.description: A destination denim boutique on Upper Grant Avenue carrying a curated selection of premium jeans and clothing from local and international brands.

shops.name: Macchiarini Creative Design
shops.description: One of the oldest studio jewelry shops in the U.S., crafting sculptural wearable art in silver and gold from a North Beach studio since 1946.

shops.name: Levi Strauss & Co. Museum
shops.description: A free museum and visitor center at Levi's Plaza on the Embarcadero North, celebrating the 150-year history of the iconic San Francisco denim brand.

shops.name: Sweetie's Art Bar
shops.description: A neighborhood art bar at 475 Francisco Street that participates in North Beach First Fridays, hosting monthly art openings and community events.

shops.name: Grocery Outlet — Bay Street
shops.description: The newly opened (August 13, 2026) discount grocery in the NorthPoint Shopping Center at 350 Bay St., filling a three-year vacancy left by the former Safeway.

shops.name: Ghirardelli Chocolate Shop
shops.description: The flagship retail and ice cream destination inside the historic Ghirardelli Square complex, selling San Francisco's most famous chocolate in all its forms.

shops.name: Jeffrey's Natural Pet Foods
shops.description: A neighborhood pet supply shop on Powell Street carrying natural and holistic food, treats, and accessories for dogs and cats.

artEntertainment.name: Bimbo's 365 Club
artEntertainment.type: Historic supper club and concert venue
artEntertainment.description: A beloved North Beach entertainment institution since 1931 hosting live rock, jazz, and pop acts in an intimate 685-seat venue with dinner seating and full service.

artEntertainment.name: Exploratorium
artEntertainment.description: Rated San Francisco's No. 1 museum, the Exploratorium at Pier 15 features 650+ interactive exhibits indoors and outdoors on the Embarcadero waterfront, plus a popular adults-only After Dark series on Thursday evenings.

artEntertainment.name: Musée Mécanique
artEntertainment.description: A free, endlessly charming museum at Pier 45 housing over 300 working vintage coin-operated mechanical arcade machines, one of the largest privately owned collections in the world.

artEntertainment.name: Club Fugazi / Dear San Francisco
artEntertainment.description: The historic Club Fugazi in North Beach hosts 'Dear San Francisco,' a contemporary acrobatic and theatrical celebration of the city produced by Les 7 Doigts de la Main.

artEntertainment.name: San Francisco Maritime National Historical Park
artEntertainment.description: A National Park Service site encompassing Hyde Street Pier's fleet of historic vessels, a visitor center, and Aquatic Park, celebrating San Francisco's seafaring heritage.

artEntertainment.name: Coit Tower
artEntertainment.description: The 1933 Art Deco tower atop Telegraph Hill features acclaimed New Deal murals inside and panoramic 360-degree views of the Bay, Embarcadero, and North Beach from its observation deck.

artEntertainment.name: Sweetie's Art Bar
artEntertainment.description: A vibrant North Beach community art venue hosting monthly rotating exhibitions and participating in the North Beach First Fridays Art Crawl.

artEntertainment.name: Live Worms Gallery
artEntertainment.description: A North Beach gallery focused on emerging and established Bay Area artists, a regular participant in the monthly First Fridays Art Crawl.

artEntertainment.name: USS Pampanito (WWII Submarine Museum)
artEntertainment.description: A restored World War II fleet submarine docked at Pier 45, open daily for self-guided audio tours through crew quarters, torpedo rooms, and the historic engine room.

gymsRecreation.name: Aquatic Park / San Francisco Maritime NHP
gymsRecreation.description: A sheltered cove at the foot of Ghirardelli Square offering calm bay swimming year-round, sandy beach, bocce courts, and the historic Bathhouse — beloved by cold-water swimmers and the South End Rowing Club.
gymsRecreation.address: Aquatic Park, Beach St. at Polk

gymsRecreation.name: Telegraph Hill (Filbert & Greenwich Steps)
gymsRecreation.description: San Francisco's most scenic urban hike, climbing through lush private gardens and wooden staircases up Telegraph Hill to Coit Tower, with wild parrots and bay vistas along the way.

gymsRecreation.name: Embarcadero Waterfront Promenade
gymsRecreation.description: A wide, flat, multi-use path along the northern Embarcadero waterfront offering unobstructed Bay views, access to Pier 39, and connections to the Ferry Building — ideal for morning runs and cycling.
gymsRecreation.address: Embarcadero at Green St. to Jefferson St.

gymsRecreation.name: Washington Square Park
gymsRecreation.description: North Beach's beloved central park hosts morning tai chi groups, picnickers, dog walkers, youth sports, and community events year-round, anchored by Saints Peter and Paul Church.

gymsRecreation.name: Crunch Fitness — North Beach
gymsRecreation.description: A full-service Crunch Fitness location serving the North Beach and Fisherman's Wharf area with cardio equipment, free weights, group fitness classes, and personal training.

gymsRecreation.name: South End Rowing Club
gymsRecreation.description: A legendary 1873 waterfront club at Aquatic Park offering open-water swimming, rowing, handball, and a community of dedicated cold-water athletes and outdoor enthusiasts.

gymsRecreation.name: Levi's Plaza Fitness Path
gymsRecreation.description: A landscaped park with walking paths, lawns, and a stream feature adjacent to the Levi Strauss & Co. headquarters campus, popular for lunchtime walks and runs along the northern Embarcadero.

gymsRecreation.name: SkyStar Observation Wheel
gymsRecreation.description: A 150-foot observation ferris wheel at Fisherman's Wharf offering gondola rides with panoramic views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, and the San Francisco Bay.
